malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal behavior would be for axios to terminate the HTTP connection or stop processing data once the maxContentLength is exceeded, preventing further resource usage. malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate HTTP clients enforce content length limits to protect against large or malicious payloads. In secure implementations, exceeding the limit should trigger an error and halt further processing.
